en: Revenue rose 96% to $2.31B, beating the ~$2.18B consensus, and EPS of $0.44 topped $0.41. US commercial revenue jumped 148% to $984M, passing US government ($953M, +96%) for the first time, and the adjusted operating margin reached 62%. Palantir raised 2026 guidance again, to $8.53B (+91%) against about $8.2B expected, with Q4 near $2.65B and free cash flow of $4.8–5.0B. CEO Alex Karp said customers move from pilot to production faster; CFO David Glazer said several large deals were shorter than usual.

Shares had slipped to $178.34 before the report and opened about 6% lower on Nov 3, because US commercial deal value grew only 11% (total contract value +6%), but closed just 1.6% lower at $175.40. The Democratic midterm sweep then hit AI and defense names: a 9.7% drop on Nov 5 left the stock at $154.99, its eighth straight loss. It rebounded 3.5% and 5.5% on Nov 6 and 9 as AI stocks recovered, closing at $168.82 on Nov 10, 3.8% below its first-session close.
zh: 营收增长 96% 至 23.1 亿美元，高于约 21.8 亿美元的市场预期；每股收益 0.44 美元，高于 0.41 美元的预期。美国商业营收大增 148% 至 9.84 亿美元，首次超过美国政府营收（9.53 亿美元，+96%），调整后营业利润率达 62%。Palantir 再次上调 2026 年指引至 85.3 亿美元（+91%），高于约 82 亿美元的预期；第四季营收约 26.5 亿美元，全年自由现金流 48–50 亿美元。CEO 亚历克斯·卡普表示客户从试点到投产的速度加快；CFO 大卫·格雷泽称数笔大单的合约期限短于往常。

股价在财报前已跌至 178.34 美元；由于美国商业合同额仅增长 11%（总合同价值 +6%），11 月 3 日开盘下跌约 6%，但最终仅收跌 1.6% 至 175.40 美元。随后民主党在中期选举中大胜，冲击 AI 与国防股：11 月 5 日股价下跌 9.7% 至 154.99 美元，为连续第八个交易日下跌。随着 AI 股回暖，11 月 6 日和 9 日分别反弹 3.5% 和 5.5%，11 月 10 日收于 168.82 美元，较首个交易日收盘价低 3.8%。

bio.en: Co-founded Palantir in 2003 with Peter Thiel and others and has been CEO since; holds a Stanford law degree and a PhD in social theory from Goethe University Frankfurt. Built the company on defense and intelligence work before its AI platform took off with corporations.
bio.zh: 2003 年与彼得·蒂尔等人联合创办 Palantir 并一直担任 CEO；拥有斯坦福法学学位和法兰克福歌德大学社会理论博士学位。公司以国防与情报业务起家，后凭 AI 平台在企业市场迅速崛起。

bio.en: Joined Palantir in 2013 and held leadership roles across finance and legal before becoming CFO in 2020. Earlier a corporate securities lawyer at Wilson Sonsini advising tech companies on IPOs and financings.
bio.zh: 2013 年加入 Palantir，在财务与法务领域担任多个领导职务，2020 年出任 CFO。此前在威尔逊·桑西尼律所任证券律师，为科技公司提供 IPO 与融资咨询。

sources.t: Nov 5 software sell-off after the midterms (Yahoo Finance)
